mentions.name: MindJam
mentions.description: MindJam analyses millions of YouTube comments to instantly reveal the unfiltered voice of an audience — true sentiment, emerging themes, and the topics they really care about — helping brands, studios and creators understand their YouTube communities. Built on top of Gemini, Claude and OpenAI using Multi-Modal RAG.
